source_row.rationale: Capnography provides real-time assessment of ventilation by measuring exhaled CO2, helping detect respiratory depression often earlier than pulse oximetry alone, which can lag behind actual ventilatory changes, particularly with supplemental oxygen use.
source_row.source_detail: Value of Capnography for Early Respiratory Depression Detection
